sources.title: Qwen3-0.6B-8bit MLX: Lightweight On-Device LLM for Apple Silicon | Open ...
sources.snippet: Qwen3-.6B-8bit Qwen3-.6B-8bit is a lightweight, 600-million-parameter language model converted to MLX format (Apple Silicon-optimized). It is a quantized 8-bit version of Alibaba's Qwen3-0.6B, suitable for on-device inference with minimal resource overhead. The model is open-source under Apache 2.0, ungated, and designed for conversational text generation on resource-constrained hardware.
